question.pt: Quais os itens mais vendidos na filial Sul no FY2026?
question.en: What were the best-selling items at the Sul branch in FY2026?

sql: SELECT b.name AS branch, s.sku, p.description, SUM(s.quantity) AS quantity, ROUND(SUM(s.quantity * s.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM part_sale s JOIN branch b ON b.id = s.branch_id JOIN part p ON p.sku = s.sku WHERE s.sold_on BETWEEN :start AND :end AND (:branch IS NULL OR b.name = :branch) GROUP BY b.name, s.sku, p.description ORDER BY revenue DESC, s.sku

answer.pt: 80 itens tiveram venda em FY2026. O líder é AD0013 (Elétrica item 13), com R$ 290.537,53.
answer.en: 80 items sold in FY2026. The top one is AD0013 (Elétrica item 13), at R$ 290,537.53.

question.pt: Quanto vendemos de peças por filial no FY2026?
question.en: How much did we sell in parts per branch in FY2026?

sql: SELECT b.name AS branch, ROUND(SUM(s.quantity * s.unit_price), 2) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) AS customers FROM part_sale s JOIN branch b ON b.id = s.branch_id WHERE s.sold_on BETWEEN :start AND :end GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY revenue DESC

answer.pt: Peças faturaram R$ 33.481.081,10 em FY2026. A filial Leste lidera com R$ 7.414.113,97.
answer.en: Parts revenue was R$ 33,481,081.10 in FY2026. The Leste branch leads with R$ 7,414,113.97.

question.pt: Qual o valor em estoque de filtros na filial Norte?
question.en: What is the stock value of filters at the Norte branch?

sql: SELECT b.name AS branch, p.part_group, SUM(k.quantity) AS quantity, ROUND(SUM(k.quantity * p.unit_cost), 2) AS stock_value FROM part_stock k JOIN branch b ON b.id = k.branch_id JOIN part p ON p.sku = k.sku WHERE (:part_group IS NULL OR p.part_group = :part_group) AND (:branch IS NULL OR b.name = :branch) GROUP BY b.name, p.part_group ORDER BY stock_value DESC

answer.pt: O estoque selecionado soma R$ 841.771,65 a custo.
answer.en: The selected stock adds up to R$ 841,771.65 at cost.

question.pt: Quais OSs estão abertas há 30 dias ou mais?
question.en: Which work orders have been open for 30 days or more?

sql: SELECT b.name AS branch, o.id AS order_id, t.name AS technician, o.opened_on, CAST(julianday(:today) - julianday(o.opened_on) AS INTEGER) AS age_days, o.revenue FROM service_order o JOIN branch b ON b.id = o.branch_id JOIN technician t ON t.id = o.technician_id WHERE o.closed_on IS NULL AND o.opened_on <= :cutoff AND (:branch IS NULL OR b.name = :branch) ORDER BY o.opened_on, o.id

question.pt: Quanto vendemos de máquinas por categoria no FY2026?
question.en: How much did we sell in machines per category in FY2026?

sql: SELECT s.category, COUNT(*) AS units, ROUND(SUM(s.revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM machine_sale s JOIN branch b ON b.id = s.branch_id WHERE s.sold_on BETWEEN :start AND :end AND (:branch IS NULL OR b.name = :branch) GROUP BY s.category ORDER BY revenue DESC

answer.pt: Máquinas faturaram R$ 170.197.868,46 em FY2026. A categoria Colheitadeiras lidera, com 32 unidades.
answer.en: Machine revenue was R$ 170,197,868.46 in FY2026. The Colheitadeiras category leads, with 32 units.

question.pt: Qual a margem de cada vendedor no FY2026?
question.en: What is each seller's margin in FY2026?

sql: SELECT b.name AS branch, v.name AS seller, COUNT(*) AS units, ROUND(SUM(s.revenue), 2) AS revenue, ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(s.revenue) - SUM(s.cost)) / SUM(s.revenue), 1) AS margin_pct FROM machine_sale s JOIN branch b ON b.id = s.branch_id JOIN seller v ON v.id = s.seller_id WHERE s.sold_on BETWEEN :start AND :end AND (:branch IS NULL OR b.name = :branch) GROUP BY b.name, v.name ORDER BY margin_pct DESC, v.name

answer.pt: Vendedor 04 tem a maior margem de FY2026: 14,0% sobre R$ 7.883.136,23.
answer.en: Vendedor 04 has the highest margin in FY2026: 14.0% on R$ 7,883,136.23.

question.pt: Quanto temos de títulos vencidos a receber?
question.en: How much do we have in overdue receivables?

sql: SELECT b.name AS branch, CASE WHEN julianday(:today) - julianday(r.due_on) <= 30 THEN '1-30' WHEN julianday(:today) - julianday(r.due_on) <= 90 THEN '31-90' WHEN julianday(:today) - julianday(r.due_on) <= 180 THEN '91-180' ELSE '180+' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS invoices, ROUND(SUM(r.amount), 2) AS amount FROM receivable r JOIN branch b ON b.id = r.branch_id WHERE r.paid_on IS NULL AND r.due_on < :today AND (:branch IS NULL OR b.name = :branch) GROUP BY b.name, bucket ORDER BY amount DESC

answer.pt: Há R$ 27.343.032,02 vencidos. A faixa 180+ da filial Leste é a maior, com R$ 5.136.960,28.
answer.en: R$ 27,343,032.02 is overdue. The 180+ bucket at the Leste branch is the largest, at R$ 5,136,960.28.
